new_profile_a.name: John H Davis
new_profile_a.notes:
[Created by split package 2026-11-27 from profile 8890.] John H Davis, b. 1738, d. 1840 (aged 101-102), buried at Holy Trinity Churchyard (Find a Grave #137944370). Split off profile 8890 under Jequan Davis's conflation ruling of 2026-11-22 (three-way split). His birth and death rest on the Davis Family Tree GEDCOM; the burial is the one non-GEDCOM support. The vital-record citations that quote his 1738 birth and 1840 death were reattached to his facts from the 1819 man's facts, where they had been cross-attached. Research is queued as item 5 of the split research register. Flagged unproven.

Verified via FindAGrave: https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/137944370/john-davis (Buried at Holy Trinity Churchyard)

new_profile_b.name: John H Davis (Son of Maurice)
new_profile_b.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-27 from profile 8890.] John H Davis, b. abt 1889, son of Morris Davis (12006) and Hester A. Morris Davis (11247). Split off profile 8890 under Jequan Davis's conflation ruling of 2026-11-22 (three-way split). The 1900 census (Indian River Hundred) enumerates him as Son, age 11, in the household of Maurice Davis (Head, age 43) and Hester A Davis (Wife, age 22), with siblings Bertha M, Stephen F, and Charley M, who are profiled as children of Morris Davis and Hester A. Morris Davis; the census head's name 'Maurice' is the same man as Morris Davis (12006), Hester's husband. The two census-document photos formerly on 8890 (the 1900 household and a WWI-era household) belong to this man and moved with him. Flagged unproven beyond the census fact.

person_8890.note_text: [Correction, john-h-davis-split package 2026-11-27: per Jequan Davis's conflation ruling of 2026-11-22, this profile was split three ways. This profile keeps John H. Davis (b. 3 Jan 1819, d. 19 Sep 1886). The 1738-1840 man (Holy Trinity burial, Find a Grave #137944370) became his own profile, 'John H Davis', taking facts 8381, 8382, 8383, 24990 and the two vital-record citations that quote his dates. The abt 1889 son of Morris Davis became 'John H Davis (Son of Maurice)', taking the 1900 census fact and the two census-document photos. The undated generic marriage fact 24991, assignable to none of the three men with confidence, was detached to the package's unassigned-evidence register. This profile was renamed from 'John H Davis' to 'John H. Davis', the name form its own kept Name fact (8263) records, so the 1738 man's profile could take the un-punctuated form his Name fact (8381) records. The child_of link to Joseph Henry Davis (8613) stays here; it carries no dates and was not assigned to either new profile.]
